description:
This dashboard shows the evolution with different panels per pollutant in indoor environments. Note that SubScenario, Area and Sensor ID filters works in cascade to adjust the desired scope easly.
In this dashboard, panels for individual Indoor Pollutants are presented.
Filtering by pilot, scenario, sub_scenario, area and even specific sensor device is allowed.

options.content:
Indoor Air Quality Pollutants
This dashboard shows the evolution with different panels per pollutant in Indoor environments.
More info about manipulating pannels in the Home screen

panels.description: Dashboard for indoor Temperature. Filtering by pilot, scenario, sub_scenario, area and specific sensor device is possible.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "AIR_QUALITY")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "CONTINUOUS_MONITORING_")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temperature")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.id_pilot =~ /^${pilot:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario =~ /^${scenario:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.sub_scenario =~ /^${sub_scenario:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.area =~ /^${area:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.sensor_id =~ /^${sensor_id:regex}$/)

panels.title: Pollutant: Temperature

list.definition:
from(bucket: "AIR_QUALITY") 
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop) 
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "CONTINUOUS_MONITORING_") 
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.id_pilot =~ /^${pilot:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario =~ /^${scenario:regex}$/) 
  |> group(columns: ["sub_scenario"]) 
  |> distinct(column: "sub_scenario") 
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])
